efficacy.measurement_rule: Independent exact AC50, EC50 and IC50 response-potency points, grouped by parent, assay, document and endpoint type. Kd and Ki affinity points are counted separately and do not establish efficacy.

exposure.measurement_rule: Admitted intrinsic-clearance median for one parent in one named assay system, with the contributing-activity range retained.

interaction.measurement_rule: Admitted exact IC50 median for one parent against CYP3A4 or CYP2D6, with contributing assay IDs and pChEMBL range retained.

toxicity.measurement_rule: No measured toxicity snapshot exists here. labs/safety_evidence/ holds constructed teaching data and contributes no compound measurement.

boundary_statement: The efficacy axis contains in vitro response-potency proxies, exposure contains in vitro intrinsic clearance rather than systemic exposure, and interaction contains CYP inhibition potency rather than a clinical interaction outcome. No toxicity measurement is available. The constructed examples in labs/safety_evidence/ are not compound measurements. Observed ranges describe the admitted records, not confidence intervals. Microsome clearance per gram of protein cannot be divided by hepatocyte clearance per million cells to claim a fold change.

rules.composite_score: Refuse every composite, weighted sum, overall desirability value or rank across families. Report the measured axes side by side.
rules.missing_family: An absent family is null and remains missing. It is never filled with a no-risk, adequate-exposure or other default.
